parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. The two methods — `PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.multipleStopCallsAreIdempotent` (line 132) and `StopBehaviorTests.stopIsIdempotent` (line 214) — appear to be intentional near-duplicate test cases that verify idempotency of stop behaviour from two different behavioural test-class perspectives. Although the Jaccard similarity is high (0.778), test methods that exercise the same invariant from different fixture contexts are a normal and desirable pattern; collapsing them risks obscuring which behavioural contract each test class is responsible for.
